title: Marijuana legalization and public health
text:
Folks, I don't want to be a prude, but we have an emerging problem with widespread daily use of marijuana in various forms. The data on increased use are not good, especially daily use, high potency varieties. This op-ed article is not advocating for a ban but sensible restrictions, similar to tobacco and alcohol. There is always tension, between freedom of choice and commonsense public health. Currently, there is no federal tax on pot, no limits to potency content of THC, or regulation on ads.  There is a middle ground we should pursue, esp. attitudes: grudging toleration.

This should not be framed as a political (partisan) issue, but as a public health issue. The data on medicinal benefits are quite limited, but the harm potential is much larger.
